{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = completed_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99

# Count QA orders
num_qa_orders = qa_mask.sum()

# Remove QA orders
completed_orders_clean = completed_orders[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders_clean['revenue'].mean()

# Print required values
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}")
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {num_qa_orders}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
